usage.reason: Host subagent tools expose no billed/token/agent-second usage. Observed dispatch-to-return intervals will provide conservative wall-occupancy accounting; unavailable metrics are not recorded as zero.
usage.method: Sum dispatch lower bounds to lead-observed return upper bounds, plus root elapsed wall. Conservative wall occupancy, not unavailable actual billed agent-seconds.

context_availability.cause: Not exposed by host; contexts no longer listed after five initial roles scheduled in waves.
context_availability.recovery: Complete initial reports preserved. Finish cross passes for available contexts, then dispatch fresh continuation actors for Product and Architecture required cross passes; not an additional quality round.

timestamp_policy: All timestamps are actual UTC clock observations. dispatch_utc is the post-dispatch observation, with a bounding interval where tool-internal timestamps were not exposed. return_utc is notification receipt observed by the lead, an upper bound on worker return. Exact internal dispatch/return times are unavailable and are not fabricated.
stopping_reason: All five initial analyses and one cross-examination pass per role completed; proceed to lead adjudication. No further round or quality retry.
deadline_observation: All reports were saved before post-dispatch observed deadlines. Exact tool-internal dispatch times unavailable; bounds and file completion times retained. No role was unfinished when its observable deadline expired.
